subject: Performance validation roadmap and mitigation milestones for FinEdge MAP
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>, ops@fintech.co
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-18 09:12 -0700
Subject: Performance validation roadmap and initial data for MAP

Hi Sara / FinEdge ops team —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our mutual action plan, attached are the initial raw benchmark exports and a draft MAP with proposed milestones. Quick summary up front so the team can triage:

- Scope: generation path (token streaming) for customer inference workloads — 1k token sequences, two model sizes (Redwood-XL-13B / rxl-13b-quant), baseline concurrency 8 and 32.
- Key measured metrics in attached CSV: 95p latency, median latency, tokens/sec (throughput), TTFT (time-to-first-token), and observed concurrency saturation.
- Immediate ask: align on reproduction method and run configs so we can agree on final MAP items and close timeline.

Top-line results (hosted run):
- Redwood-hosted (region: us-west-2): median latency 210ms / 95p 520ms at concurrency 8; throughput ~1,600 tokens/sec; TTFT 85ms.
- At concurrency 32 we see 95p spike to 1.1s and throughput plateauing near 3.8k tokens/sec.

Notable discrepancy vs your earlier vendor snapshot: your test showed 95p ~320ms at concurrency 16. We believe differences likely from: sequence length mix, KV cache warmup, and client-side batching.

Attachments: finedge-benchmark-raw.csv, MAP-v1.3.docx, run-configs.txt

Proposed next steps (short):
1) FinEdge to run the attached run-configs.txt on their infra (or share runner access) — due Aug 21. Owner: FinEdge ops (Sara).
2) Redwood infra team to reproduce locally using identical config and share reproducer script — due Aug 22. Owner: Karthik.
3) Joint triage call if results diverge >20% on 95p latency — schedule Aug 24.

Please confirm owners and any constraints (network egress, private images) so we can lock the MAP and associated close timeline.

Best,
Vanessa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: finedge-benchmark-raw.csv)
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@fintech.co, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-18 11:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Performance validation roadmap and initial data for MAP

Vanessa — thanks for the export and the clear asks. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we run:

- The snapshot we shared earlier used a sequence-length distribution skewed to shorter prompts (avg ~220 tokens); your baseline average looks higher. We'll run the exact configs in run-configs.txt but also include a short-seq profile so we can compare both.
- We use a client-side aggregation window of 40ms which may reduce observed TTFT; will send our http client config.
- We can run the reproducer in our staging cluster (EKS) but need an image or script for the exact runner — please provide.

Owner confirmations: Sara (FinEdge) will run by Aug 21; ops@fintech.co will share logs and traces (redacted) with Redwood.

Can Karthik confirm whether you require any special kernel or CUDA driver pinning? We are on a mixed fleet (A10G + H100) so hardware variance could matter.

Thanks,
Sara
SRE Lead, FinEdge
(attachment: none)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-18 12:15 -07:00
Subject: Re: Performance validation roadmap and initial data for MAP

Thanks — adding some reproduction guidance from infra that should reduce a lot of false discrepancies: 

1) Please use the attached run-configs.txt verbatim (we included seed, prompt mix, and KV cache warmup steps). KV-cache warmup: run 5 calibration requests at target seq length and discard.
2) Pin the runtime to our inference image (redwood/infer:v2027-07-30) — it contains updated attention kernels and stable batching heuristics. If you cannot use the image, note which runtime you use and the --batch-window value.
3) If running across mixed GPU types, please run homogeneous batches per GPU class and aggregate after — mixing GPU families in the same job will skew 95p.

Quick note on TTFT: TTFT is sensitive to client buffering and TLS session setup. For parity measure, we prefer a warmed TCP connection + HTTP/2 multiplexing.

I'll push a reproducible script to the shared Drive link and include a small docker-compose that runs the same harness on a single-GPU node.

Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: run-configs.txt)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>
Date: 2027-08-18 15:02 -07:00
Subject: Re: Performance validation roadmap and initial data for MAP

Looping product/CS context — quick competitive note from our evaluation team after looking at the csv: VendorX's public numbers were using lower max sequence lengths and disabled kv caching in their reported runs, which explains their lower 95p at moderate concurrency. That said, their throughput at scale drops off faster than ours.

Proposed MAP milestone additions:
- Milestone A (Aug 21): FinEdge staging run + logs. Owner: FinEdge.
- Milestone B (Aug 22): Redwood reproduce with identical config + shared reproducer. Owner: Karthik.
- Milestone C (Aug 24): Joint triage call (15–30m) if 95p difference >20% or throughput delta >25%. Owner: Vanessa to schedule.
- Milestone D (Aug 30): MAP close or escalation to execs with agreed remediation (config changes, quantization profile, or fallback routing). Owner: Vanessa / FinEdge AMs.

Also: can the FinEdge team confirm whether audit logs / perf traces can be shared under our NDA for deeper analysis? If not, we will rely on the reproducer and aggregated metrics.

Thanks,
Marissa
Staff Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-19 09:08 -07:00
Subject: Re: Performance validation roadmap and initial data for MAP

Thanks — confirmed. We ran the verbatim run-configs.txt against our staging cluster this morning (homogeneous A10G nodes). High-level from our side:

- Short-seq profile (avg ~220 tokens): 95p latency 360ms at concurrency 16; TTFT 70ms; throughput ~1.8k tokens/sec.
- Long-seq profile (avg ~1k tokens): 95p latency 540ms at concurrency 8; TTFT 82ms; throughput ~1.5k tokens/sec.
- Logs / aggregated traces uploaded to the shared Drive link (redacted). We could not share raw audit logs due to compliance, but we included trace summaries and p95 histograms.

We see discrepancy vs Redwood-hosted run primarily in TTFT and the 95p at concurrency 8 for long sequence workloads — looks within the threshold you flagged, but please confirm Redwood reproduce results.

Sara
SRE Lead, FinEdge
(attachment: finedge-staging-traces.zip - referenced)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-19 16:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Performance validation roadmap and initial data for MAP — confirmed milestones and meeting invite

Great — thanks for the quick run and for uploading traces. Karthik and team, will you validate reproducibility against FinEdge's short-seq and long-seq artifacts? If our reproduce shows >20% divergence on 95p or >25% on throughput we'll go to the triage call Aug 24 at 11:00am PT (inv sent).

I created MAP-v1.3.docx and updated the milestone owners and dates (see Drive link). Summary of agreed owners and dates:
- Aug 21: FinEdge staging runs + upload (Sara). — done
- Aug 22: Redwood reproduce + deliver reproducer script (Karthik).
- Aug 24: Joint triage call if required — Vanessa to host.
- Aug 30: MAP close (either verified parity or set remediation plan).

If any of the owners foresee blockers (images, driver pinning, or required infra access), flag here by EOD Aug 20 so we can adapt the timeline.

Thanks all — looking forward to closing this in the MAP runway.

Best,
Vanessa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: MAP-v1.3.docx)
